integrity: A direct polynomial proof and symbolic verifier cover every algebraically closed characteristic-five field. Finite-field enumeration is corroborative, not a substitute for algebraic proof. No independent audit has occurred.
limitations: The theorem classifies Cartier-power ranks, not complete Ekedahl–Oort types or Newton polygons. Five coefficients parameterize marked equations, not distinct unmarked isomorphism classes. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Complete higher Cartier-rank stratification in a genus-14 Artin–Schreier family
